question: Will the temperature hit 25°C in NYC on Oct 16, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the observed temperature at the Central Park, NYC weather station (KNYC) reaches 25°C (77°F) or above at any point strictly after 2026-10-16T04:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-17T04:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the observed temperature at the Central Park, NYC weather station (KNYC) does not reach 25°C (77°F) at any point strictly after 2026-10-16T04:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-17T04:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- Temperature is determined using the hourly or sub-hourly surface observations recorded at KNYC (Central Park) for the full calendar day of October 16, 2026 UTC; a single observation at or above 25°C (77°F) within the window is sufficient for "Yes".
